i.norm:
Creates a test file containing {@code lineCount} lines, opens a {@link LineIterator} over it, and verifies that:
  • {@code remove()} always throws {@link UnsupportedOperationException}
  • each line returned by the iterator matches the expected content
  • the total number of lines read equals {@code lineCount}
  • both {@code next()} and {@code nextLine()} throw {@link NoSuchElementException} once the iterator is exhausted
remove() is unsupported regardless of file content
After the iterator is exhausted, both retrieval methods must throw
Writes {@code lineCount} sequentially-numbered lines to {@code file} using the given {@code encoding}, and returns those lines for later comparison against the iterator output.
Returns a list of {@code lineCount} strings of the form {@code "LINE 0"}, {@code "LINE 1"}, …, {@code "LINE (lineCount-1)"}.

Verifies that a {@link LineIterator} over an empty file is immediately exhausted: {@code hasNext()} returns {@code false} on the first call, and both {@code next()} and {@code nextLine()} throw {@link NoSuchElementException} without ever entering the iteration loop.
